discogs.notes:
This is the original 1979 Swedish pressing with the original design for the labels. The now iconic iceberg logo was adopted by Polar as their corporate logo from 1982 onwards. 

Recorded & mixed at Polar Music Studio, Metronome Studio, Marcus Music, Bohus Studio & Glen Studio.

All tracks published by Bocu Music Limited, except "Chiquitita", Music For Unicef.

"Rock Me" is from the LP "[r1286108]".
"Dancing Queen", "[r695274]".
"Eagle", "I Wonder (Departure)", "Take A Chance On Me", "Thank You For The Music" & "The Name Of The Game" are from the LP "[r767377]".
"Angeleyes", "Chiquitita" & "Does Your Mother Know" are from the LP "[r403181]".

℗ & © 1975, 1976, 1977 & 1978 Polar Music International AB.

Comes in a gatefold sleeve.

Available on cassette PMC 312
